1. Decision Making: Prepares, and coordinates the preparation of, statistical metadata for storage and dissemination, reviewing, editing and validating statistical metadata; undertaking quality evaluations in accordance with documented standards and relevant policies, directives and guidelines; and determining priorities and target dates.

Identifies corporate and client metadata requirements, estimates the time required to complete tasks and assesses issues related to the production, storage, dissemination and evaluation of statistical metadata in order to provide direction to clients and management with respect to possible approaches, priorities, target dates and client training needs and to resolve conceptual and technical problems.

Identifies the need to update statistical metadata in response to modifications in client, policy or systems requirements and in response to revised standards, methods and procedures. Determines priorities and timelines for making required updates.

Determines the need for, recommends, implements and tests modifications to methods, procedures and systems used in the production, storage, dissemination and evaluation of statistical metadata, advising clients of changes to methods and procedures and advising clients and management of potential impacts and results.

Writes reports, documentation, procedures manuals and training materials which are related to the production, storage dissemination and evaluation of statistical metadata and which are reviewed by managers and distributed internally.
2. Leadership And Operational Management: Coordinates the activities of work groups established to conduct and implement program activities: assigns work; provides feedback on performance of working group members; monitors progress against objectives and provides guidance and direction to working group members; identifies financial and human resource needs.
Monitors and tracks time spent on activities for the purposes of reporting to management and informing planning activities.
3. Communication: Liaises with other statistical metadata specialists, subject matter specialists, survey managers and management in order to develop and translate requirements into specifications for the production, storage, dissemination and evaluation of statistical metadata and to suggest improvements to methods, procedures and systems. Provides assistance, advice and specialized training to subordinates and clients.

Writes and presents detailed documents, procedures manuals and training manuals which explain and clarify the methods, procedures and systems used to produce, store, disseminate and evaluate statistical metadata and which are used by other statistical metadata specialists, clients, and management in the maintenance and enhancement of statistical metadata management programs.

Writes reports which describe statistical metadata policy requirements and the results of metadata quality evaluations and which are used by clients and management in the maintenance and enhancement of statistical metadata management programs.
4. Knowledge of specialized fields: Knowledge of statistical metadata concepts and frameworks used within Statistics Canada, the Government of Canada and internationally, and knowledge of how those concepts and frameworks are used, and reflected in, policies, methods and procedures relating to the production, storage, dissemination and evaluation of statistical metadata in order to ensure the accurate and efficient preparation, editing and validation of statistical metadata and to ensure that colleagues and clients understand the importance of adhering to policies, methods and procedures in the preparation, storage and dissemination of metadata.

Knowledge of methods, procedures and systems used for producing, storing, disseminating and evaluating the quality of statistical metadata and the potential impacts of new or modified methods, procedures and systems on workloads, outputs and clients in order to establish priorities, timelines and training plans; to recommend improvements to methods, procedures and training; and to explain the methodology and results of metadata quality evaluations.

Knowledge of survey and statistical program subject matter concepts, methods and techniques relevant to the collection, processing, certification and dissemination of data in order to assess client requirements for metadata production, storage and dissemination and to more accurately and efficiently assess the quality of statistical metadata.
Knowledge of software, statistical packages and programming languages used in the production, dissemination and evaluation of statistical metadata.
5. Contextual knowledge: Knowledge of policies, directives and guidelines directly and specifically related to the production, storage, dissemination and evaluation of statistical metadata in order to coordinate the preparation, editing and validation of statistical metadata; to provide assistance, advice, direction and training to clients; and to report on metadata quality.

Knowledge of contacts within key client Divisions in order to establish a liaison, evaluate program statistical metadata requirements, provide assistance, advice and direction with respect to policy requirements, methods, procedures, systems and training relevant to the production, storage, dissemination and quality evaluation of statistical metadata.

Knowledge of surveys and statistical programs within Statistics Canada in order to locate, analyze and compare related statistical metadata and to identify, evaluate and ensure consistency in the methods of processing, storing, disseminating and evaluating the quality of metadata across programs.

Knowledge of the Statistics Act and of Statistics Canada policies, directives and guidelines in order to ensure understanding and application of the Act and these policies, directives and guidelines in the production, storage, dissemination and quality evaluation of statistical metadata.
The position must have an awareness of the Statistics and Privacy Acts with respect to the security and confidentiality of statistical information to ensure that actions are in compliance.
6. Research and analysis: Identifies diverse sources from which statistical metadata can be extracted in order to improve the quantity and quality of statistical metadata disseminated.

Analyses client requirements in order to determine the feasibility of, and options for, producing, storing, disseminating and evaluating the quality of statistical metadata consistently within and across survey and statistical programs.

Reviews current production, storage, dissemination and evaluation methods, procedures and systems to ascertain their relevancy and to propose changes or alternative methods, procedures and systems which would result in operational efficiencies and/or improvements in the quality of statistical metadata.

Analyzes changes in methods, procedures and systems used to produce, store, disseminate and evaluate the quality of statistical metadata in order to determine the need to update statistical metadata or adapt it to new formats; to determine where updates are required to existing documentation, procedures manuals and training manuals; and to determine potential impacts on clients.
Analyzes and evaluates statistical metadata with respect to policy and procedural requirements, consistency across survey and statistical programs and other pre-defined quality measures.

Competencies: Showing Initiative and Being Action Oriented
